text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон has a magnificent debut
race and is
practically overflowing with
motivation after it
ends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has a rival that she's hoping to
compete with
at a big event, and that
person is none other than
her peer
Нарита Брайан, the current favorite for the

Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон is raring to climb to new
heights in
order to make her dream
come true. We decide
to make the junior
G1 Hanshin J.F. our next stop!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
